start.ask_sheet: Share your Google Sheet with {email} as Editor, then send the sheet URL.
start.ask_sheet_no_email: Share your Google Sheet with the service account email as Editor, then send the sheet URL. The key file is not set up on the bot yet.
start.sheet_saved: Created tab "{title}". Existing tabs were left unchanged.
start.ready: Hi {name}. What would you like to do?

errors.bad_url: Send a Google Sheet link, like https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/...
errors.not_shared: I cannot open that sheet. Share it with {email} as Editor, then send the URL again.
errors.sheet_failed: I could not set up the sheet. Try again in a moment.
errors.bad_number: Send a number greater than zero.
errors.bad_date: Send a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or pick one below.
errors.bad_name: Send a name up to 100 characters.
errors.bad_currency: Send a currency up to 16 characters, such as MMK.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.need_setup: Send /start to link a Google Sheet first.
errors.tab_missing: The transactions tab is missing. Link a sheet again from Settings.
errors.sheet_changed: Those rows changed. Start Delete again.
errors.no_credentials: The Google service account key is missing on the bot.

income.ask_name: What is the description for this income?
income.confirm_amount: Amount is {amount} {currency}. Confirm, or type a different amount.

outcome.ask_name: What is the description for this outcome?
outcome.confirm_amount: Amount is {amount} {currency}. Confirm, or type a different amount.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ask_currency: Send the currency to show after amounts, such as MMK.
settings.confirm_sheet: Replace the linked Google Sheet? The old spreadsheet will not be changed.
settings.sheet_kept: The Google Sheet is not updated.
